name: Risk-based, time-boxed
description: When there isn't time to test everything: rank cases by risk and decide explicitly what to skip.
promptDelta:
Assume testing time is limited.
- Rate each test case by likelihood and impact (High / Medium / Low), based on the risk areas given, and rank by the combination.
- Split the cases into three groups: must run before release, run if time allows, and accept the risk.
- For each accepted risk, say what production monitoring, alert or feature-flag rollback would catch or contain a failure.

name: Audit-ready (regulated)
description: Adds IDs, traceability, evidence and sign-off for regulated or audited environments.
promptDelta:
Make the plan audit-ready:
- Give every test case an ID and expected result.
- Add a traceability matrix (Requirement | Test IDs | Status) linking each requirement in the feature description to its tests.
- State the evidence to capture for each case (logs, screenshots, signed-off results).
- Define entry and exit criteria and the sign-off roles.
Do not name a specific regulation unless the inputs mention one.

name: Non-functional focus
description: Adds performance, accessibility, security and resilience testing to the functional plan.
promptDelta:
Add a non-functional testing section:
- **Performance**: load and latency targets (use `[DATA NEEDED: ...]` if none are given) and the scenarios to run.
- **Accessibility**: keyboard navigation, focus order, screen-reader labels and color contrast against the current WCAG AA level.
- **Security**: authorization checks, input validation and rate limits.
- **Resilience**: timeouts, retries and degraded behavior for each dependency listed.
Include test stubs for the performance and accessibility checks, using tools that fit the test framework given (or common open-source tools if none is given).

name: Exploratory testing charters
description: Complements scripted cases with time-boxed exploratory sessions aimed at the riskiest areas.
promptDelta:
Add 4–6 exploratory testing charters focused on the risk areas given.
- Format each as "Explore <area> with <resources or data> to discover <information>".
- Time-box each (for example 60 minutes) and list what to look for.
- Add a short session report template: charter, tester role, duration, bugs found, questions raised, areas not covered.
